newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end mixed, volume remains thin.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end mixed, volume remains thin.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed mixed in volume estimated at a scant 1,000 lots.
Thursday's official volume was 816 lots, NYCE said.
The Benchmark September contract closed 0.05 cent firmer at 74.45 cents a lb after trading from 74.90 to 74.25 cents. The rest settled 0.15 higher to 0.15 weaker.
The overall trend remains weaker, with nearby support pegged at 74.00 cents followed by 73.50 cents for September juice.
In the longer term, the spot month could ease to 70.00 to 65.00 cents amid a continued set of fundamental factors, analysts said.

The latest USDA supply and demand report pegged the 1996/97 crop at a record 225.7 million 90-lb boxes. The agency put the 1997/98 Brazilian Sao Paulo crop at 400 million boxes, up from 366 million boxes in the current season.
